title: Italian-Style Roasted Carrots
description: A simple and delicious side dish featuring roasted carrots with Italian flair.

ingredients.name: rosemary
ingredients.notes: Fresh or dried, chopped for best flavor

instructions: Peel and chop the carrots into 1-inch pieces.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped carrots to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil and spice mixture.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the carrots in a single layer.
Roast the carrots in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and caramelized.
Remove the carrots from the oven and let cool slightly.
Serve the roasted carrots hot, garnished with chopped fresh rosemary if desired.
